description: Something that came in from outside, kept as it was captured: a page, a post on another platform, a file. Your words about it are blocks. Kept as _sources/<id>/source.json, with extracted.md beside it when its text is kept and original.<ext> when its bytes are.

uri.description: Where it lives: an HTTP(S) address, an AT URI, a local path or a Google Drive path.

platform.description: Lower case: x, substack, arena, website, drive, local...

platformId.description: The platform's own ID, so capturing it again finds the same source.

retain.description: How much is kept: reference (where it is, nothing more), text (its text in extracted.md), full (its bytes too).

meta.description: Anything else the connector found, kept as it came.
